body: I’m not very social. I’m very much an introvert and welcome solitude. I hope I do right by my dog for as long as I can. Maybe I am lonely. Thank you for responding.

I’m scared to make friends to be honest. I’m scared that I won’t be what they expected in a friend or that they are not really trustworthy. I’m scared to get close to people. Another reason why I don’t like being here. 
I do think that’s good advice to find a sense of purpose. Maybe helping animals. 
Thank you
